candidate_name: Trithemius Polygraphia sequential word-alphabet strict core
classification_scope: bounded first-pass code-bearing stream; no Voynich scoring licensed

source_authorities.provider: Herzog August Bibliothek witness via Trithemius Corpus
source_authorities.authority_note: The 1518 scan is the primary witness. The corpus reading text is a navigation/reading layer and must not be used to silently repair table cells.
Falconer independently describes the ordered use of Trithemius alphabets and reproduces several complete initial alphabets.

plaintext_inventory.note: Table labels in the authority control lookup. No modern normalization beyond the documented 24-letter inventory is licensed.

recovered_architecture.code_unit_boundary: visible word separation in the public Latin cover stream
recovered_architecture.encoder_step: For plaintext letter position t, take the word labelled by that letter from the next alphabet in sequence; do not skip an alphabet.
recovered_architecture.table_scale_reported: more than 9000 Latin words under almost 400 alphabets in Book I

restart.rule: For long hidden matter the source permits beginning again from the head as often as necessary; continuation from the end of Book I into Book II is also documented.
restart.h0_bounded_policy: No restart is exercised in the bounded H1 preflight; H1 must remain within the frozen consecutive table prefix.

out_of_sequence_words.historical_role: optional/auxiliary public-discourse completion where the table lacks sufficient synonymous connective material
out_of_sequence_words.strict_core_policy: Exclude them from the code-bearing representation. H1 may not select or tune filler words.

plaintext_spaces_and_punctuation.recoverability: The inverse recovers the hidden Roman-letter stream. Hidden lexical spacing/punctuation is not encoded by the word-alphabet stream and therefore is outside exact recoverability.

recovered_architecture.double_letters: encoded as two successive letter positions using two successive alphabets
recovered_architecture.inverse: At each code-bearing position, use the corresponding alphabet to map the observed table word back to its labelled plaintext letter; concatenate recovered letters.
recovered_architecture.within_alphabet_collision_policy: The Clavis warns that duplicate or missing words within an alphabet cause confusion and requires corrected copies; a frozen executable table must reject within-alphabet duplicate mappings.
recovered_architecture.cross_alphabet_collisions: Permitted in principle because alphabet position is part of decoder state; must be audited in the frozen executable prefix.

historical_crosscheck_prefix.use_constraint: This prefix may support only a bounded external round-trip preflight of at most three code-bearing positions unless additional consecutive source-verified alphabets are frozen first. No cyclic reuse of this three-alphabet excerpt is allowed.

charge_components: exact serialized table cells used by the executable candidate
table/source edition identifier and frozen hash
start alphabet index if other than the documented first position
any table transposition or private permutation
r10_accounting.h1_rule: The H1 artifact must serialize and hash the exact bounded table prefix and report its byte/bit cost. No table byte may be selected from Voynich behavior.
r10_accounting.future_tournament_rule: A full-corpus target tournament is not licensed until the exact full table actually used is source-verified, serialized, hashed and charged.

h1_license.success_condition: deterministic encode and inverse reproduce the input 24-letter stream exactly using only the frozen consecutive source tables

reason_for_classification: The historical mechanism no longer has the T1463-style missing encoder-choice problem: source authority specifies one codeword per secret-letter position from consecutive alphabets, forbids skipping alphabets, explains non-code filler words, documents restart/continuation options, and states the inverse reading procedure. Full overt-style generation remains non-unique because filler and long-message restart choices exist, but a bounded first-pass code-bearing encoder/inverse is fully specified without inventing target-conditioned rules.
next_action: Run one bounded external-only H1 round-trip using the frozen three-alphabet prefix; if it passes, freeze whether additional source-table digitization is scientifically worth the cost before any Voynich exposure.
